name: Havertys
outlook:
What Havertys says to expect

  • Full year 2026: gross profit marginOur expectations for gross profit margins for 2026 are between 61.3% to 61.5%, an increase from our previous guidance due to the receipt of IEEPA tariff refunds.
  • Full year 2026: fixed and discretionary SG&AFixed and discretionary expenses within SG&A for the full year of 2026 are expected to be in the $307.0 to $309.0 million range, unchanged from our previous guidance.
  • Full year 2026: variable SG&AVariable SG&A expenses for the full year of 2026 are anticipated to be in the 19.2% to 19.4% range, an increase from our previous guidance due to higher delivery, transportation, and third-party credit costs.
  • Full year 2026: effective tax rateOur effective tax rate for 2026 is expected to be 26.0%, excluding the impact from discrete items and any new tax legislation.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresPlanned capital expenditures for the full year of 2026 are approximately $34.0 million, unchanged from our previous guidance.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
